description: Read the selected gene_id and immutable snapshot_id from resolve_gene. Returns overview, disease validity, dosage, mechanisms, transcripts, native assemblies, constraint, ClinVar summaries and consequences, expression, GWAS, phenotypes and protein/pathways with source assertions, coverage, count units and null values. get_gene_section supplies further pages. Live search_gene_literature is separate from the snapshot literature section.

gene_id.description: Canonical HGNC gene_id returned by resolve_gene. Select an explicit candidate when resolution is ambiguous.
gene_id.title: Gene Id

snapshot_id.description: identity_snapshot_id returned by resolve_gene, or snapshot_id from the current gene profile. Restart resolution after snapshot_unavailable.
snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id

name: get_gene_profile
title: Read the complete gene profile
